body.x: SONY participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced XPERIA XA2 and XPERIA EAR.

XPERIA XA2 has an enhanced camera function. With this, it is possible to capture the beauty of life and the moment. There is a mobile sensor video recording function, which provides excellent color and clarity. The screen on the camera is wide enough to take a picture of favorite scenery, and the XPERIA XA2 is also convenient for users to use because its size fits in a hand. Xperia Ear is nothing but a personal assistant. Various functions such as message transmission / reception, schedule check, search and exploration and so on can be performed freely without carrying the mobile phone.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
